info.title: Solana JSON RPC API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the Solana blockchain JSON RPC API. All requests are POST to the RPC endpoint using JSON-RPC 2.0.

post.description: Send a JSON-RPC 2.0 request to the Solana cluster. Use the `method` field to specify the RPC method.

method.description:
Name of the RPC method to invoke. Each method targets a specific piece of cluster state or submits work to the network:

- **getAccountInfo** – Returns all information associated with the account of the provided pubkey.
- **getBalance** – Returns the lamport balance of the account of the provided pubkey.
- **getBlock** – Returns identity and transaction information about a confirmed block in the ledger.
- **getBlockHeight** – Returns the current block height of the node.
- **getBlockProduction** – Returns recent block production information from the current or previous epoch.
- **getBlocks** – Returns a list of confirmed block slots between two slot values.
- **getBlocksWithLimit** – Returns a list of confirmed blocks starting at a given slot, up to a maximum count.
- **getBlockTime** – Returns the estimated production time of a confirmed block as a Unix timestamp.
- **getClusterNodes** – Returns information (gossip address, TPU address, software version, etc.) about all nodes participating in the cluster.
- **getEpochInfo** – Returns information about the current epoch (epoch number, slot index, slots-in-epoch, transaction count, etc.).
- **getEpochSchedule** – Returns the epoch schedule (slots per epoch, leader schedule slot offset, etc.) from the cluster's genesis config.
- **getFeeForMessage** – Returns the fee the network will charge for a particular base-64-encoded message.
- **getFirstAvailableBlock** – Returns the slot of the lowest confirmed block that has not been purged from the ledger.
- **getGenesisHash** – Returns the genesis hash of the cluster.
- **getHealth** – Returns the current health of the node; returns "ok" when healthy, otherwise an error.
- **getHighestSnapshotSlot** – Returns the highest full and incremental snapshot slots the node has available.
- **getIdentity** – Returns the identity public key of the current node.
- **getInflationGovernor** – Returns the current inflation governor parameters (initial rate, terminal rate, taper, foundation allocation).
- **getInflationRate** – Returns the specific inflation values (total, validator share, foundation share) for the current epoch.
- **getInflationReward** – Returns the inflation and staking reward earned by a list of addresses during a given epoch.
- **getLargestAccounts** – Returns the 20 largest accounts by lamport balance, optionally filtered by account type.
- **getLatestBlockhash** – Returns the latest blockhash and the last block height at which it will be valid.
- **getLeaderSchedule** – Returns the leader schedule (validator-to-slot mapping) for a given epoch.
- **getMaxRetransmitSlot** – Returns the highest slot seen from the retransmit stage.
- **getMaxShredInsertSlot** – Returns the highest slot seen after shred insertion.
- **getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption** – Returns the minimum lamport balance required for an account of a given byte-size to be exempt from rent.
- **getMultipleAccounts** – Returns the account information for a list of up to 100 pubkeys in a single call.
- **getProgramAccounts** – Returns all accounts owned by the provided program pubkey, with optional data filters.
- **getRecentPerformanceSamples** – Returns a list of recent performance samples (transactions per second, slots) in reverse slot order.
- **getRecentPrioritizationFees** – Returns a list of per-compute-unit prioritization fees observed in recent blocks.
- **getSignaturesForAddress** – Returns confirmed transaction signatures involving a given address, ordered from newest to oldest.
- **getSignatureStatuses** – Returns the confirmation status and error (if any) for up to 256 transaction signatures.
- **getSlot** – Returns the slot that has reached the given (or default) commitment level.
- **getSlotLeader** – Returns the public key of the current slot leader.
- **getSlotLeaders** – Returns the ordered list of slot leaders for a given slot range.
- **getStakeActivation** – Returns the epoch activation and deactivation state for a stake account.
- **getStakeMinimumDelegation** – Returns the minimum stake delegation amount in lamports.
- **getSupply** – Returns the total, circulating, and non-circulating lamport supply of the cluster.
- **getTokenAccountBalance** – Returns the SPL Token balance (amount, decimals, UI amount) of a given token account.
- **getTokenAccountsByDelegate** – Returns all SPL Token accounts for which the given pubkey is the approved delegate.
- **getTokenAccountsByOwner** – Returns all SPL Token accounts owned by the given pubkey, optionally filtered by mint or program.
- **getTokenLargestAccounts** – Returns the 20 largest holders of a particular SPL Token mint.
- **getTokenSupply** – Returns the total circulating supply of an SPL Token mint.
- **getTransaction** – Returns the full transaction details (message, signatures, metadata, logs) for a confirmed transaction.
- **getTransactionCount** – Returns the total number of transactions that have been confirmed by the ledger since genesis.
- **getVersion** – Returns the current Solana software version (`solana-core` semver and feature-set identifier) running on the node.
- **getVoteAccounts** – Returns the account info and associated activated stake for all voting accounts in the current bank, split into current and delinquent sets.
- **isBlockhashValid** – Returns whether a given blockhash is still valid (i.e. has not expired).
- **minimumLedgerSlot** – Returns the lowest slot that the node has information about in its ledger (slots below this have been purged).
- **requestAirdrop** – Requests an airdrop of a specified number of lamports to a pubkey. Only available on devnet and testnet.
- **sendTransaction** – Submits a fully-signed, serialised transaction to the cluster for processing and returns its signature.
- **simulateTransaction** – Simulates executing a transaction without submitting it to the network, returning logs, account states, and units consumed.

params.description: Method parameters. The structure depends on the method being called.

result.description: The result of the RPC call. Structure varies by method.

slot.description: The slot at which the response was evaluated

Commitment.description: The level of commitment desired for the query

data.description: Account data encoded as base58, base64, base64+zstd, or parsed JSON

executable.description: Whether the account contains a program

owner.description: Base-58 encoded public key of the program this account has been assigned to

rentEpoch.description: The epoch at which this account will next owe rent

space.description: The data size of the account

rewards.description: Whether to populate the rewards array

slotIndex.description: Current slot index within the epoch

slotsInEpoch.description: Number of slots in this epoch

identity.description: The identity public key of the current node

taper.description: Rate per year at which inflation is lowered

foundation.description: Percentage of total inflation allocated to the foundation

foundationTerm.description: Duration of foundation pool inflation in years

epoch.description: Epoch for which these values are valid

lastValidBlockHeight.description: Last block height at which the blockhash will be valid

result.description: Minimum lamports required for rent exemption

prefixItems.description: Array of transaction signatures to confirm

searchTransactionHistory.description: If true, search the entire transaction history

err.description: Error if transaction failed, null if succeeded

result.description: The current transaction count from the ledger

feature-set.description: Unique identifier of the current software feature set

value.description: true if the blockhash is still valid

prefixItems.description: Pubkey of account to receive lamports

skipPreflight.description: If true, skip preflight transaction checks

maxRetries.description: Maximum times for the RPC node to retry sending the transaction

minContextSlot.description: Minimum slot to evaluate the request

result.description: First transaction signature embedded in the transaction

sigVerify.description: If true, the transaction signatures will be verified

replaceRecentBlockhash.description: If true, replace the transaction's recent blockhash with the latest

err.description: Error if transaction failed, null if succeeded

logs.description: Array of log messages output during simulation

unitsConsumed.description: Number of compute budget units consumed during processing

limit.description: Maximum number of signatures to return (default 1000)

before.description: Start searching backwards from this signature

err.description: Error if transaction failed, null if succeeded

blockTime.description: Estimated production time as Unix timestamp

activatedStake.description: Stake delegated to this vote account, in lamports

epochVoteAccount.description: Whether the vote account is staked for this epoch

commission.description: Percentage of rewards payout owed to the vote account

withContext.description: Wrap the result in an RpcResponse JSON object

filters.description: Filter results using various filter objects

prefixItems.description: Pubkey of Token account to query

amount.description: Raw balance without decimals, as u64 string

decimals.description: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place

uiAmountString.description: Balance as string using mint-prescribed decimals

result.description: Slot of the lowest confirmed block not purged from ledger
